description: Find the public IP address your network shows to websites, displayed large with a one-click copy button.

faqs.a: It calls the site's /api/ip endpoint, which returns the IP address your request came from — the public IP your network presents to websites.
It shows your public IP (as seen by the internet). If you are behind a VPN or proxy, it shows the VPN/proxy exit IP.
faqs.q: Does it show my real IP or my VPN IP?

faqs.a: Only a single request to /api/ip is made to detect the address. Nothing is stored or tracked.

howto: Open the tool — your IP is detected automatically.
Read the large IP address display.
Click Copy IP to copy it to your clipboard.
Click Refresh to detect it again.
title: IP Address Finder
